title: Digital IDs Work At 250 Airport Checkpoints—But Most States Still Say No
hook: Digital IDs work at 250 checkpoints, but most states still say no.
closing: Your phone is replacing airport ID slowly, so travelers still need plastic backup.
question: Would you trust a digital ID?

segments.say: Digital IDs work in 20 states, nearly doubling their airport reach in a short rollout.
Digital IDs reached 250 checkpoints, making phone-based screening practical at far more airport lines.
Digital IDs still exclude 30 states, so most travelers cannot depend on them everywhere.
